intro: Rolf and Malakai's Medallions bear the realm's insignia, but their owners vanished on patrol in eastern Elwynn Forest. Guard Thomas seeks the tokens to learn what became of his men.

p: Guard Thomas, station commander in eastern Elwynn, feared the worst when Rolf and Malakai vanished along the riverbanks. Their medallions confirm the guards died at the hands of encroaching murlocs. For the Stormwind garrison, these tokens mark the loss of soldiers who held the line against wilderness threats while the kingdom's military was stretched thin.
